note: Snapshot from publicly visible product descriptions; not an exhaustive audit. Features, availability and terms can change. Re-check before external uniqueness claims.

matrix.name: SEBI / NSE / BSE
matrix.capabilities: Regulatory filings, offer documents, public issue information, exchange disclosures and investor education.
matrix.implication: Treat these as authoritative source destinations, not competitors to a source-linked research workflow.

matrix.name: Trendlyne
matrix.capabilities: Upcoming/open/recent IPO dashboard, DRHP/RHP links, subscription categories and listing gain/loss analysis.
matrix.implication: Basic IPO calendars, subscription tables and listing dashboards are saturated.

matrix.name: BeaconCaps
matrix.capabilities: IPO Insights, forensic prospectus reads, use-of-proceeds coverage and post-listing accountability tracking.
matrix.implication: K1/K2 cannot be claimed unique. Test differentiation through cross-IPO object/quarter normalisation, preserved RHP baselines, source-page evidence and reproducible validation.

matrix.name: CredoNomics
matrix.capabilities: Published quantitative IPO score methodology using growth, returns, cash conversion, leverage and peer valuation.
matrix.implication: Avoid unexplained composite scores. Show raw inputs, formulas, source dates and coverage.

matrix.name: IPOWATCH
matrix.capabilities: Current and upcoming issues, GMP and subscription / allotment tracking.
matrix.implication: Do not build another live-GMP clone. Keep GMP out of the core proposition.

matrix.name: GMP Today
matrix.capabilities: Publicly describes multiple-source GMP aggregation, timestamps and historical accuracy data.
matrix.implication: Optional GMP research only after licence, methodology, attribution and SEBI review; GMP is not official exchange data.

matrix.name: SEBI Investor Education
matrix.capabilities: Official investor education and offer-document guidance.
matrix.implication: Academy must add applied examples tied to reviewed issuer filings rather than copy generic explainers.
